notes: New Plans tab: plan a flight by clicking the map (take-off point, then waypoints with height, speed and pause)
Shows distance, flight time and battery use, based on your own past flights
Safety warnings: height limit (400 ft), too far to see, low battery at landing, strong wind, rain, cold, after sunset
Weather for the planned time at the take-off point (free, from Open-Meteo)
Save plans, open them again, and compare with a past flight
Planner limits can be changed in Settings → Flight planner
